raised: The page gives no numbers, fees, risk information or guidance for someone their age
Unclear what the 'השוואה למטרה' menu item does
The small grey line under 'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון' is hard to read
'מאיפה להתחיל' speaks to salaried workers; nothing for someone near retirement
Couldn't see the names of the three cards under 'כסף שוטף וקצר', only the ends of their text
The period set by law for tax-free withdrawal is not stated
The 'בשפה פשוטה' line for the comprehensive pension fund isn't plain language, just the same words reordered
The 'קרן חדשה כללית' description (deposits above the maximum) is confusing
Most of the 'לבחירה עצמית' card texts couldn't be seen
The seven index cards sound alike and say nothing about risk or suitability
The 'יומית' / 'מתחדשת' buttons on the money-market fund are not understood
Grey subtitles on the black background are too faint
The general track description doesn't say how much is in shares
The 'exposure to the dollar or hedged' phrase is unclear
'Weighted by market value' is not understood
The difference between MSCI World and MSCI AC World, and between TA-35 and TA-90, is unclear
'אישית לפיצויים' is unclear: is it severance pay, and can they touch it
Can't find when money can be withdrawn and what withdrawal costs
Can't find anything about tax on withdrawals after 60
Can't find how to tell which products they already have
Would drop the 'לבחירה עצמית' and 'לילדים' sections as not relevant

problems.why: The reader mentions the general track among the exposure rows, but only complains that its definition doesn't say how much is in shares (item 13). They never object to it being listed as an exposure when it is really a mix.
